_note: Synthesised narration for the social cut. Line 1 says what the marketplace is, line 6 names the project, and line 9 is the invitation: the film's job is to send people to something they can touch, not to close a story.

lines.text: Eleven at night on an expert marketplace. Forty seven waiting, three experts online, all on a call.
Twelve more are offline. Nobody told them.
At foodpanda I raised the incentive and riders appeared.
That does not work on a therapist. You cannot price a credential into existence.
They never declined. Nobody asked. Supply is fixed. Information is not.
So I built Equilibrium. Five modules that watch both sides and ask, in seconds.
The surge pays the bonus, so it funds itself. Nine accept, the delay halves, and it cost the platform forty dollars.
You cannot surge price a therapist. You can make sure nobody finds out too late.
Every module in this film is live on the site. Go and drive it yourself.
